games.name: CNA Simulator
games.desc:
Work as a CNA in a busy hospital ER!
Team up with friends to run the ER and help tons of patients coming in nonstop! Complete different tasks to care for patients and level up to unlock new ranks and roles.

You can work in the ER, ICU, PACU, and Pharmacy — with more hospital units coming soon! Explore a huge hospital full of secrets and surprises.

This game is in BETA, so there might be bugs and glitches, but we’re constantly adding new updates every few weeks to make it even better!

Disclaimer: This game is for fun and doesn’t always reflect the real duties of a CNA.

Tags: CNA, Nurse, Hospital, ER, Roleplay, Multiplayer, Simulation
